title: Nutrient Solution for Rice Hydroponics Culture
author: John Platten
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wg6fbze

steps.title: Prepare Main Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1L of the main stock solution using de-ionised water and specific reagents.

substeps.instruction: Start with ~600mL de-ionised water.
Weigh out and dissolve each component (except ferric chloride and citric acid) directly in the 600mL solution, allowing each to dissolve completely before adding the next.
Add KOH pellets slowly, a few at a time, with constant mixing.
Dissolve citric acid separately in 100mL de-ionised water.
Dissolve ferric chloride 6-hydrate directly in the citric acid solution.
Stir the ferric chloride-citrate solution for 15 minutes, then add slowly to the main stock solution while stirring.
Make up the final volume to 1L.

steps.title: Prepare Calcium Nitrate Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1L of calcium nitrate stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve calcium nitrate 4-hydrate directly in 700mL de-ionised water.
Make up the final volume to 1L.

steps.title: Prepare Magnesium Sulfate Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1L of magnesium sulfate stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve magnesium sulfate 7-hydrate in 700mL de-ionised water.
Make up the final volume to 1L.

steps.title: Prepare Optional Sodium Metasilicate Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1L of sodium metasilicate stock solution (optional).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 4.50g sodium metasilicate 9-hydrate in 700mL de-ionised water.
Make up the final volume to 1L.

steps.title: Prepare 1x Hydroponics Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 100L of 1x hydroponics solution for growth trays.

substeps.instruction: Prepare ~90L of water.
Mix in 100mL of each stock solution, mixing well before adding the next stock solution.
If sodium metasilicate was not prepared as a stock solution, add sodium metasilicate 9-hydrate at a concentration of 0.00450g/L and dissolve with stirring.
Adjust pH to 5.5.
Dispense the solution to growth trays.

steps.title: Maintain Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Perform daily and weekly maintenance of the stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Monitor and adjust pH of stock solution daily to pH 5.5 using KOH/HCl as required.
Refresh stock solution twice per week.
